channel.title: Mulligan Magazine — Channel Breakdowns
channel.description: Daily content strategy podcast for outdoor cinematographers. Emma breaks down top-performing videos, competitor strategies, and your own uploads — delivered to your podcast app every morning, Monday through Friday.
channel.itunes:author: Connor Mulligan

item.title: Mulligan Growth Series Ep 6: Brand Building and 75-Day PMC Content Plan
item.description: Emma breaks down what the Mulligan Magazine brand actually is based on Connor's existing videos — and how to pivot from skiing into cycling and fly fishing without losing identity. Plus: a full 75-day content strategy for the Pan Mass Challenge, covering YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok.
item.itunes:author: Connor Mulligan

item.title: Channel Breakdowns Ep 4: Cycling Niche Strategy
item.description: Today's episode covers the cycling content landscape — why gravel and adventure cycling outperforms pure road cycling on YouTube, the 3 pillars for outdoor cycling channels, how to build a vulnerability hook series, and the brand deal milestones ahead.
item.itunes:author: Connor Mulligan

item.title: Channel Breakdowns Ep 3: Fly Fishing Niche Strategy
item.description: Today's episode covers the fly fishing content landscape — sub-niches ranked by viral potential, the 3 content pillars that work for outdoor cinematographers, seasonal river series structure, and the affiliate monetization path from 3K to 25K followers.
item.itunes:author: Connor Mulligan

item.title: Mulligan Growth Series Ep 2: The Wild Fly Productions Breakdown
item.description: Emma goes deep on the most-watched fly fishing video on YouTube — 'A Week of Fly Fishing in Alaska' by Wild Fly Productions. 3 million views, sparse narration, silence as a storytelling tool, and 8 specific lessons Connor can apply to his own edits.
item.itunes:author: Connor Mulligan

item.title: Mulligan Growth Series Ep 1: Your Channel at a Glance
item.description: In this debut episode, Emma breaks down the Mulligan Magazine YouTube channel from the outside looking in — 7 videos, 1 breakout hit, and a clear path forward. Covering: what's working, what isn't, and the foundation you need to start building real momentum.
item.itunes:author: Connor Mulligan
